hatchloop/readiness.summary: Substring keyword rules on English text, not a language model: 'stop' or 'cancel' anywhere in a message sets the intent. A hint for your agent to check, never a decision.

description: Classify an inbound message for an SMB and get a suggested_action for YOUR agent to act on. English keyword rules (booking request, cancellation, opt-out, inquiry, complaint): treat the intent as a hint. Opt-outs are recorded durably; nothing else is auto-routed or executed. [$0.03/per_call] [async→get_outcome] [beta]

idempotency_key.description: Retry key: a 24h replay returns the original receipt, not re-run or charged.
